scientific.integrity: The claim is derived from the published exact dispersion relations by a fresh local band-edge expansion through cubic order in inverse mode number, followed by a summable-width argument. A standard-library numerical replay solves the exact boundary equations and checks the second-order coefficients. Published width asymptotics, later energy-probability work, momentum-density literature, and recent preferred-orientation spectral-statistics work were compared at the statement and implication level.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is restricted to the equilateral square and hexagonal lattices with the cyclic preferred-orientation coupling in the source normalization. It concerns energy-set Lebesgue measure and does not address momentum density, density of states, magnetic perturbations, incommensurate edges, or other couplings. The O(1) cumulative remainder need not converge because of cutoff phase.

title: Bounded finite-energy remainders for preferred-orientation square and hexagonal quantum lattices
